# Repository Instructions

- Follow Ruff lint rules
- Prefer type hints
- Use FastAPI best practices
- Avoid duplicated logic
- Write clean and readable code
- Prefer dependency injection

## Language Standards

- Use English for identifiers, variable names, function names, classes, and code comments.
- Pull request reviews and reviewer feedback should be written in Portuguese (Brazilian Portuguese).
- PR review comments should be concise and written in Brazilian Portuguese.
